summary: Be weary of the warmth in a poet's smile for it sparks many a fire unleashing desire to rain on flames of forgotten folklore strickling streams causing creases of dreams escaping folds of time while the work of a smirk hides a wordsmith's intention #poetryport #clmooc #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Be weary of the warmth in a poet's smile
for it sparks many a fire
unleashing desire to
rain on flames
of forgotten
folklore
strickling streams
causing
creases of dreams
escaping folds
of time
while
the work of a smirk
hides a wordsmith's
intention
#poetryport
#clmooc
#smallpoems
